# StreamDek Mobile v2.1.23

Stronger adult-content protection across every source, more reliable plugin sync between your
devices, and better details for add-on titles.

## What's New

**Stronger adult-content protection**
When adult-content protection is on, explicit repositories, plugins, providers, live channels and
titles are now kept out of Home, search, browse pages, live channels, your watchlist, Continue
Watching and the player, whichever source or add-on they arrive through. Protection now
recognises sources that try to slip through with renamed titles, extra punctuation, look-alike
letters or joined-up names, and checks playlist channels by their playlist identity as well as
their display name.

**CloudStream collections that label themselves adult are blocked**
CloudStream plugins that declare themselves adult (NSFW) can no longer be switched on or loaded,
and collections that describe themselves as **+18** or **NSFW**, or contain only adult plugins,
can no longer be added. Collections with a mix of content keep their ordinary plugins. Only the
adult ones are removed.

**Protection updates reach the screen straight away**
When StreamDek updates its protection rules, the app applies them the next time it opens or
returns to the foreground. Anything newly restricted disappears from what you are already
looking at, and rows that would be left empty are removed rather than shown bare.

## Improvements

**More reliable plugin sync between devices**
Changes to your plugins now upload one at a time. Quick edits are combined into a single upload,
and brief network failures are retried automatically. A change that has not finished uploading is
no longer overwritten by an older copy from another device.

**Better details for add-on titles**
Films, series and live channels from add-ons are now recognised more reliably, so their details,
artwork and episode information are found more often and live channels are no longer mistaken
for series.

**Protection that stays on offline**
The app remembers the most recent protection rules. If StreamDek cannot be reached, those rules
stay in force and blocking stays switched on. A rule update that cannot be verified as coming
from StreamDek is ignored.

**More helpful crash reports**
When something goes wrong, StreamDek now records clearer diagnostic details so problems can be
found and fixed faster.

**More of the app in your language**
Player messages (such as **Intro skipped**, **Recap skipped** and **No subtitles found**), download
statuses and episode watched labels are now translated in all supported app languages, along with
the new playback message for restricted content.

## Fixed

- Fixed restricted titles sometimes remaining visible on screen or in cached pages until the app
  was restarted after protection rules changed.
- Fixed adult plugins inside large "all-in-one" collections, and previously enabled adult
  plugins restored from a backup or another device, being loaded when protection was on.
- Fixed playback of a restricted title starting from Continue Watching, a remembered source or a
  direct link. It is now stopped before the video starts.
- Fixed playlist channels with a harmless display name bypassing protection when their playlist
  identity matched a restricted source.
- Fixed plugin changes sometimes failing to reach your other devices when an upload was
  interrupted or several edits were made quickly.
- Fixed the mpv player occasionally freezing or crashing when the video surface was recreated,
  for example while rotating the screen or switching apps.
- Fixed several player and download messages appearing in English regardless of your app
  language.

## Quick Setup

- **Nothing to set up:** Protection follows your StreamDek account settings and updates
  automatically.
- **Already have an adult CloudStream collection installed?** Its plugins will no longer load.
  Open the collection in CloudStream settings and refresh or remove it to clear them from the list.
- **Something ordinary was blocked by mistake?** Let StreamDek support know the title and where
  you found it, so it can be reviewed.
